commitments.detail: The event will be held on October 15, 2023.
Observations will take place on the south patio.
The event will start at 8:00 PM and end at 11:00 PM.
We will observe the Moon, Mars, and the Pleiades star cluster.
Ensure the telescope is covered when not in use.
Use the red-light lantern to minimize light pollution.
